thread:
sara: kicking off region-staggered deploy v3.0.0-rc1. plan: US (10%) -> EU (25%) -> APAC (65%), with a soft-pin window and an emergency partial-rollback play. holdpoints after each region. window is 18:00-20:00 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Rollout started: release=v3.0.0-rc1 rollout_id=rl-20240502-300 target_regions=[us-east-1] slice=10%

ryan: routing pin note: we'll flip /prod/model/current -> v3.0.0-rc1 in config-service at the end of US holdpoint. making the change now in staging for checksum verification.

chris-sre: preflight results: us-east-1 spare capacity OK. GPU util baseline 60%, headroom ~40%. warm pool: 6 spare. thermal margin good. Prom alerts set: p95=280ms, 5xx-rate=0.4% sustained 5m.

oncall-sre: added synthetic smoke with traffic-tag=smoke/rollout for 2m after canary to validate tail.

deploy-bot: Canary OK. logs: 
```
2024-05-02T18:02:21Z canary-ok
health: OK
p95: 145ms
p99: 290ms
5xx: 0.01%
```

maria-ml: running model-validator on canary outputs: no statistical drift vs baseline, perf delta <0.5% for sampling. good to proceed.

sara: US holdpoint clear. flipping soft-pin in config-service now (nonblocking). will proceed to EU in 3m.

deploy-bot: Starting EU ramp: eu-west-1 initial 10% for 4m -> 25% if stable. rollout_id=rl-20240502-300-B

chris-sre: EU baseline p95=230ms, headroom lower (25%). suggest conservative ramp as planned. watch p99 closely.

oncall-sre: EU canary shows p99 ~410ms under synthetic spike for 20s, recovered. placing hold: require p99 < 380ms for sustained 3m before full 25% ramp.

sara: acknowledged. pausing EU ramp, starting diagnostic synthetic.

deploy-bot: EU ramp paused at 10% pending holdpoint.

ryan: question on rollback policy: for this release let's approve region-local rollback (EU only) if EU 5xx > 0.6% for 4m OR p95 > 400ms for 6m. global rollback only if multiple regions fail. This keeps US traffic unaffected.

ops-lead: approved. ensure runbook step for partial rollback is followed: 1) throttle EU slice to 0% 2) revert routing pin for EU to previous stable tag 3) roll-back model in control plane 4) notify customers.

chris-sre: we ran more load sim. p99 dipped to 370ms and held. EU ramping to 25% now.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 25% complete. health: p95=260ms p99=360ms 5xx=0.04%

maria-ml: ML checks still green. embedding similarity drift = 0.2%.

oncall-sre: APAC capacity note: ap-northeast-1 thermal event earlier today reduced available GPUs by 30%. headroom now ~8%. we need fallback plan.

sara: mark APAC high-risk. plan: hold APAC until EU steady 15m. if APAC can't accept full slice, we'll apply quantized fallback v3.0.0-q4 for ap regions. need ops-lead ack for fallback toggle.

ops-lead: acked. fallback toggle command `/ops fallback --region ap-northeast-1 --model v3.0.0-q4` (requires ops-lead + oncall ack).

chris-sre: EU metrics trending well. starting APAC rollout now but at reduced initial ramp: 40% with quantized fallback applied as needed. deploy_id=rl-20240502-300-C

deploy-bot: APAC ramp in progress. initial target 40% (of global). health preliminary: p95_apac=300ms p99_apac=520ms 5xx_apac=0.12%

maria-ml: APAC p99 high on some long-context tests. fallback quantized variant would reduce latency but we should sanity-check output quality.

oncall-sre: thermal spike in ap-northeast-1 just hit; CPU/GPU throttling observed on 2 hosts. triggering fallback now.

ops-lead: executing fallback. `/ops fallback --region ap-northeast-1 --model v3.0.0-q4` -> ack from ops-lead and oncall. routing switch in progress.

deploy-bot: Fallback applied for ap-northeast-1. APAC slice now serving mixed traffic: 60% quantized q4, 40% full model. snapshot: p95_apac=210ms p99_apac=330ms 5xx_apac=0.07%

sara: good recovery. continuing to monitor. request team watch for any quality complaints for the quantized variant.

chris-sre: new signal: EU p99 creeping up from 360ms -> 420ms in last 3m correlated with one AZ experiencing higher tail latencies. single-AZ issue ratio = 1.8x cluster avg.

ryan: recommending we isolate that AZ from EU routing and continue. if isolation doesn't bring p99 down in 2m, initiate partial rollback for EU only.

oncall-sre: isolating eu-west-1b (suspending local LB) now. routing adjusted.

deploy-bot: Traffic rebalancing executed: eu-west-1b removed from pool. new EU p99=290ms p95=250ms 5xx=0.05%

maria-ml: model outputs unchanged. no drift.

sara: great catch. no rollback needed. we'll keep eu-west-1b isolated for 10m and investigate host-level issue.

chris-sre: follow-up: eu-west-1b showed kernel OOMs on one GPU process; we patched kernel param and rebooted node. bringing it back slowly via canary.

ops-lead: node healthy and rejoining. monitor for recurrence.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: US=10% EU=25% APAC=65% (APAC using q4 fallback partially). Final metrics global p95=205ms p99=315ms 5xx=0.05%

ryan: publishing release notes summary and tagging runbook: https://internal/doc/releases/v3.0.0-rc1 and runbook https://internal/runbooks/partial-rollback. please file any post-deploy anomalies in #incident if detected.

sara: thanks team. closing holdpoints and archiving deploy logs. will post an ops postmortem doc if the APAC thermal event needs deeper RCA. :white_check_mark:
